text.en: Atlas cells original design study. Eyepiece 10×; objectives 4×, 10×, 40×; field number 18 mm. Total power = 10 × objective = 40×, 100×, 400×. Object-field diameter = 1000 × 18 / objective = 4500, 1800, 450 µm. Focus tolerance widths = 20, 8, 2 µm; clarity proxy = max(0, 1 − abs(focus − layer depth)/width). Cell models enlarged separately 2000×: plant envelope 80×40×25 µm; animal 60×45×8 µm. Wall/membrane thickness exaggerated. Six plant chloroplast shapes, one large plant vacuole and one nucleus per cell are illustration choices. All specimen positions, layers, blur mappings and instrument dimensions are authored teaching geometry.
text.zh: Atlas 原创设计研究：目镜 10 倍；物镜 4、10、40 倍；视场数 18 毫米。总倍数＝10×物镜倍数＝40、100、400 倍；物方视野直径＝1000×18÷物镜倍数＝4500、1800、450 微米。调焦容差＝20、8、2 微米；清晰度代理量＝max(0,1−焦差绝对值÷容差)。细胞另行放大 2000 倍：植物细胞包络 80×40×25 微米，动物 60×45×8 微米；壁膜厚度额外夸张。植物叶绿体形状 6 个、大液泡 1 个，各细胞核 1 个，均为绘图选择。标本位置、深度、模糊映射及仪器尺寸均为教学设计。

note.en: Original Atlas design, not measured biology or a calibrated optical image. Field formula supported by S22; total power and inversion by S7/S3. With a 100 µm target, the span occupies 2.222…%, 5.555…%, 22.222…% of diameter. Onion target centre x=200 µm; slide-x=−200 µm centres it; at slide-x=−100 µm and objective40, u=−100/225=−0.444444…. At objective40, focus error1 µm gives clarity0.5 and error2 gives0; this is not resolution. No large coarse-focus actuation. All material paraphrases and original geometry remain in the project CC BY-NC-SA family.
note.zh: 原创设计，不是生物实测或经校准光学影像。视野公式见 S22，总倍数与倒像见 S7、S3。100 微米目标横跨直径的 2.222…%、5.555…%、22.222…%。洋葱目标中心 x=200 微米，slide-x=−200 时居中；−100 时在 40 倍物镜下 u=−100/225=−0.444444…。该物镜焦差 1 微米时代理量 0.5，2 微米时为 0；这不是分辨率。只开放微调。原创几何及释义保持项目 CC BY-NC-SA 许可家族。
